description: Enter a version and bump type to get the exact next semver, including prerelease handling.

faqs.a: major, minor, patch, premajor, preminor, prepatch, and prerelease — all per the semver spec.
Build metadata (+build) is dropped on any bump, as the spec recommends.
prerelease on 1.2.3-beta.1 gives 1.2.3-beta.2; on 1.2.3 it gives 1.2.3-<tag>.1.
Yes — versions are parsed strictly (optional leading v) and invalid input is rejected.

howto: Pick a bump type and optional prerelease tag.
Click Calculate — the next version appears.
title: SemVer Calculator
